# Frozen companyfacts for the LTM-window pins

`tests/test_anchor_ltm_window.py` reads these. They track NO page and are never regenerated by
`scripts/build_companyfacts_fixture.py`: each freezes a real filer whose anchor D&A must cover the
window its page's LTM EBIT and revenue cover
(`docs/records/2026-10-28-the-anchors-d-and-a-covers-its-ltm-window.md`).

Cut 2026-10-28 from the shared SEC cache, unmodified apart from the tag subset: every alias of D&A
and revenue (`CONCEPT_ALIASES`) and D&A's split substitute tags, `sort_keys` and `indent=1`.
**Checked at cut time, against the full blob:** `_window_dep_amort` on the page's window returns
the same result, and the newest fiscal year (`filer_fiscal_year`) ends on the same day, named by
the same tag.

| file | filer (CIK) | fetched | the page's window | what it pins |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `BURL.json` | Burlington Stores (1579298) | 2026-10-26 | LTM to 2026-08-01 | fiscal year + year-to-date − prior year-to-date: $449.908M, where the anchor read FY2025's $417.871M |
| `V.json` | Visa (1403161) | 2026-10-26 | LTM to 2026-06-30 | no D&A year-to-date reaches the window: refused, never FY2025's $1,220M |
